topic.working_title: LLM 排行榜没有中立选项:选项顺序和提示措辞如何制造模型排名
topic.angle: 以一篇新 arXiv 论文为核心,解释为何多选题基准的分数会随选项顺序、prompt 措辞和答案读取方式而变化,并且波动恰好集中在那些区分模型优劣的关键题目上。
topic.reason: 该论文直接质疑主流 LLM 排行榜的可信度,技术含量高、证据来自一手 arXiv 论文,对从业者和普通读者都有解释价值;与近期讨论模型可解释性的主题不重复,提供了新的评测视角。

sources.title: There Is No Neutral Harness: Modern LLM Leaderboards Are Manufactured by Config-Fragile Items
sources.summary: arXiv:2608.21382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiple-choice benchmarks fix the questions and the correct answers, but not the harness: the order of the options, the wording of the prompt, and whether a language model's answer is read from generated text or from per-option likelihoods. Work on this harness sensitivity reports it as aggregate score variance, leaving unexamined which items the variance falls on and whether they are the items that separate one model from the next.
